turns.content: Can you save cards for repeat customers? And would that change our PCI compliance level?

Hi Olivia! 

Yes, Acme Checkout allows you to securely save cards for repeat customers using tokenization. 

Because we handle and store the card details on our hosted, secure servers, your PCI compliance level won't increase. Your store remains at the lowest level of PCI scope (typically SAQ A), as sensitive cardholder data never touches your servers. 

Please let us know if you'd like guidance on enabling saved cards for your checkout!

turns.content: Bonjour! How do I show prices in EUR instead of USD at checkout?

Bonjour Chloé!

To display your prices in EUR (€) at checkout, you can update your currency settings directly in your dashboard:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Localization & Currencies**.
2. Under **Default Currency**, select **EUR (€)** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click **Save Changes**.

Once updated, your checkout will present all prices in EUR. If you'd also like to offer multi-currency options so international shoppers can view their local currency, you can toggle that on in the same settings tab.

Please let us know if you have any questions!
